core_categories: Home Healthcare Equipment; Respiratory Therapy; Sleep Health; Negative Pressure Wound Therapy; Continuous Glucose Monitoring; Enteral Nutrition
specialty_focus: Apria is a leading U.S. home healthcare equipment provider, delivering medical gear, clinical support, and supplies directly to patients at home. It specializes in high-touch in-home care for chronic conditions, with core product lines including respiratory therapy, sleep health, negative pressure wound therapy, and continuous glucose monitoring. Apria operates as part of Accendra Health's Patient-Direct segment, serving patients across all 50 states.
